verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is documented as a serverless, fully managed cloud data warehouse, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable edition of the MotherDuck service. The nearby items do not qualify. The local MCP server for 'self-hosted scenarios' is only an MCP connector. Enterprise support for on-premise deployments covers the open-source DuckDB engine, not MotherDuck. DuckLake's bring-your-own object storage still runs on MotherDuck-managed compute. All of these are adjacent features or underlying-engine capabilities, so they earn no credit.
